LESSON: ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.5: Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Oral Expression, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What makes a good oral presentation?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen and repeat saying the names of sports and games after a recording (e.g. 足 球、篮球、网球、乒乓球、羽毛球 etc.),

2. make simple sentences with vocabulary related to sports and games in turns (e.g. 运 yùndòng、比赛 bǐsài、 踢足球 tī zúqiú、打篮球 dǎ lánqiú、打排球 dǎ páiqiú etc.),

3. simulate a game/ sport and have their peers guess the appropriate name collaboratively,

4. take turns to talk about their preferences for sports and games using 我喜欢 Wǒ

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen and repeat saying the names of sports and games after a recording (e.g. 足 球、篮球、网球、乒乓球、羽毛球 etc.),
2. make simple sentences with vocabulary related to sports and games in turns (e.g. 运 yùndòng、比赛 bǐsài、 踢足球 tī zúqiú、打篮球 dǎ lánqiú、打排球 dǎ páiqiú etc.),
3. simulate a game/ sport and have their peers guess the appropriate name collaboratively,
4. take turns to talk about their preferences for sports and games using 我喜欢 Wǒ

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: The learner uses digital technology to effectively accomplish own tasks when they search online for the

importance of engaging in sports and games.

Values:
Unity: The learners respect other people’s opinion as they listen to their peers talk about their preferred sports and games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Mental health: The learner acknowledges the importance of physical activity in promoting positive mental health and emotional

well-being.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner relates to Creative Arts on the concept of utilising sports and games to enhance well-being.
